cloudProvider.description: Cloud service provider that serves the requested endpoint service.

errorMessage.description: Error message returned when requesting private connection resource. The resource returns `null` if the request succeeded.

id.description: Unique 24-hexadecimal digit string that identifies the Private Endpoint Service.

regionName.description: Cloud provider region that manages this Private Endpoint Service.

status.description: State of the Private Endpoint Service connection when MongoDB Cloud received this request.
